selection: Complete public train and development releases, normalized into context and question/answer CSV tables. The hidden test set is not included.
notes: Attribution: Pranav Rajpurkar, Robin Jia, Percy Liang and the SQuAD/Wikipedia contributors. Replaces Doc2Dial to use an explicitly redistributable source. Paragraph IDs are derived keys; all question, passage and answer text and source split assignments are retained. answers_json preserves multiple answer spans. Impossible means unanswerable from its supplied paragraph, not necessarily unanswerable from the entire corpus. This is general document QA rather than a company policy corpus.
